content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Ph.D. degree in Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Molecular Biology or a related field; At least two research paper in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal; Fulfil the guidelines of DST-OM number DST/PCPM/Z-06/2022 dated June 26, 2023 Other conditions: Candidates must fulfil the guidelines of DST-OM number DST/PCPM/Z-06/2022 dated June 26, 2023. Reservation of post shall be as per Govt. of India norms. Desirable: Research experience in functional genomics, plant molecular biology, gene-editing, tissue culture and bioinformatics, supported with relevant publications, will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for BRIC-NIPGR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Canvassing in any form or bringing influence, political or otherwise, will lead to disqualification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary position, co-terminus with the project; the project is valid until August 2028. Initial appointment is for one year or till the tenability of the project, whichever is earlier. Appointment can be curtailed or extended based on assessment of performance and discretion of the Competent Authority. Appointment may be terminated at any time by giving one month's notice by either side. Applicants have no claim for consideration against any regular position of BRIC-NIPGR.

content_sections.heading: How Will BRIC-NIPGR Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Online interview of shortlisted candidates Interview is held online. Interview link will only be sent to shortlisted candidates. NIPGR reserves the right to select the candidate depending upon qualification and experience.
